citations.claim: energy still within bound before crush at step 35
light bottom body ejected upward at 140.6 m/s at violating step
total energy 4455.27 J exceeds allowed 4274.65 J at first violating step

explanation: Heavy body (20kg) falling onto a vertical stack crushes light bodies (0.2kg, 1kg) against the floor with restitution 1. Sequential pairwise impulses plus positional correction pump energy: light bodies are ejected at ~140 m/s and ~39 m/s, raising total energy from 3881.5 J to 4455 J, exceeding the 10%+5J bound. Substep count rises (81 substeps) but does not prevent the energy injection from the crush chain.
vision_note: A large circle drops straight down onto two much smaller circles stacked vertically above the floor. By step 38 the stack is crushed together at the bottom with all three bodies in tight contact.
